name: CNPJá
summary: Brazilian company registry (CNPJ) data: establishments, companies with partners, Simples Nacional and Receita Federal records, and filtered searches.

api_key.description: A CNPJá commercial API key (cnpja.com account), sent as the raw Authorization header value with no prefix.

notes: Credits (₪): an online CNPJ lookup costs 1, a cached one 0; add-ons (simples, suframa, geocoding, registrations) add 1 each. Company, person-by-id and postal-code lookups are free. Searches cost 1 per 10 records.
strategy=CACHE never charges; it returns 404 when nothing is cached. sync=true makes the response carry the charge in the cnpja-request-cost header.
CNPJ and CPF values are digits only. A company id is the first 8 digits of the CNPJ (the root); an establishment is the full 14-digit CNPJ.
Searches page with the token returned by the previous page; a token excludes every other filter. Filter names are dotted (names.in, address.state.in) and lists are comma-separated.
Docs and field descriptions are in Portuguese. The keyless public API at open.cnpja.com is a separate, rate-limited service not in this entry.

endpoints.name: Look up a CNPJ
endpoints.summary: One establishment: legal and trade name, status, address, phones, emails, activities (CNAE), partners, and optional Simples, state registrations, SUFRAMA and geocode.

simples.description: +1 credit: add Simples Nacional and MEI status.

simplesHistory.description: +1 credit: add past Simples and MEI periods.

registrations.description: +1 credit (CCC) or +1 per state (SINTEGRA): state registrations for these UFs, comma-separated; ORIGIN or ALL also accepted.

registrationsSource.description: Source for state registrations; default AUTO.

strategy.description: CACHE: cache only, never charged, 404 when absent. CACHE_IF_FRESH: cache within maxAge, else online. CACHE_IF_ERROR (default): as CACHE_IF_FRESH, falling back to cache within maxStale if online fails. ONLINE: always online (prefer maxAge=1).

maxAge.description: Days a cached record is accepted; default 45.

maxStale.description: Days a cached record is accepted when the online lookup fails (CACHE_IF_ERROR); default 365.

sync.description: Settle credits synchronously and return the cnpja-request-cost header.

notes: 1 credit online, 0 from cache, plus add-ons.

endpoints.name: Search establishments
endpoints.summary: CNPJs matching filters on name, status, founding date, address, activity (CNAE), size, Simples/MEI, phones and emails.

token.description: Paging token from the previous page; excludes every other filter.

names_in.description: Terms in the legal or trade name: space-separated must all match one company, comma-separated match different ones.

status_id_in.description: Registration status codes, comma-separated: 1 null, 2 active, 3 suspended, 4 unfit, 8 closed.

activities_id_in.description: Main or secondary CNAE codes, comma-separated.

founded_gte.description: Opened on or after this date.

founded_lte.description: Opened on or before this date.

head_eq.description: true: head offices only; false: branches only.

company_size_id_in.description: Company size codes: 1 micro (ME), 3 small (EPP), 5 other.

phones_ex.description: true: only establishments with a phone.

emails_ex.description: true: only establishments with an email.

endpoints.name: Get a company
endpoints.summary: A company (CNPJ root) with all its partners and establishments.

companyId.description: The first 8 digits of the CNPJ.

notes: Free; served from cache, refreshed every 30 days.

endpoints.name: Search people
endpoints.summary: Partners and administrators by name, type, partial CPF/CNPJ, age band or country.

token.description: Paging token from the previous page; excludes every other filter.

name_in.description: Names: space-separated must all match one person, comma-separated match different ones.

taxId_in.description: CPFs or CNPJs, comma-separated; CPFs match on digits 4 to 9 only.

endpoints.name: Get a person
endpoints.summary: One person and the companies they are a partner in.

personId.description: The person's CNPJá id, from a search or a company's partners.
